headers.responsibility: Existing monolithic header layout and all consumers
headers.tests: Layout identity, all290 assertions, MSVC constant expressions, old module refusal, C23 bootstrap
headers.blocker: Exact include composition and ABI identity; pending header fragments are not admitted

roots.responsibility: All root source adapters and actual writer closure
roots.tests: Existing RC/bank/stack/symkey/globals PBT, moving roots, nonzero processor, caller census and failures
roots.blocker: Remaining raw writers and full source/exit census, not a one-time mark_rc
roots.ordering: after current getters; before independent worker composition

capacity.responsibility: Physical copy/restoration reservations and unique allocation authority
capacity.tests: Census bound, contiguous interval packing, CAS-loss refund and actual failure custody
capacity.blocker: Complete source/frame upper bounds and real physical layout; never increase heap

workers.responsibility: Collector worker task ownership and W!=R restoration
workers.tests: W<R, claimed/private/Tail work, worker exit, map multi-shot GC and unknown join
workers.blocker: No carrier-index authority; all root tasks and restoration owners accounted

retirement.responsibility: VM membership publication and resource-specific retirement
retirement.tests: Partial startup/create/join/unknown results, healthy VM continues GC
retirement.blocker: All roots/worker debts transferred; unknown owner cannot be declared dead by timeout

scheduling.responsibility: FIFO mailbox lock/publication and service activation ownership
scheduling.tests: Official scheduler populations, ordered shared values, real PBT replay/shrink
scheduling.blocker: Separate source-root freeze, lock handoff and request service activation; repair9 remains independent workload

entries.responsibility: FFI write authority and acquired-effect cleanup
entries.tests: Actual SFUN/CFUN/catcher/marker nested exit, RC writers and Tcl lifetime
entries.blocker: Complete writer/borrow admission and exit custody; do not promise all CFFI in first root REV
entries.ordering: after root writer closure and worker interface

build.tests: Same cache two builds, C-only rebuild, complete source bootstrap and official tests
build.blocker: Source/tool/profile identity and failed producer custody; no new executor/profile
build.ordering: parallel support lane; commit only minimal audited slices

ci.responsibility: Publish only validated test entrypoints and manifests
ci.tests: Actual GitHub jobs on exact revision, namespaced existing tests, fixed limits
ci.blocker: Do not fold runtime fixes into workflow edits or infer remote green from local
ci.ordering: after referenced source and test targets are published

generated.responsibility: Exact generated C cohort follows its qualified Scheme producer
generated.tests: Reproducible complete cohort and distribution source/tool identity
generated.blocker: Never a standalone handwritten REV; do not commit partial stale generated products
generated.ordering: attached to its producing source cut
